post.originalText:
Same one-shot prompt, two AI setups: a 30s cinematic F1 pit stop in Three.js. Detailed car, 8-person crew changing all 4 tyres, synthesized audio, fully procedural.

🟠 Claude Opus 5.5 (orchestrator) + Claude Haiku 5.5 (executor)
• Opus: 94.8M tokens, $34.50
• Haiku: 819.9M tokens, $61.77
• Total: 914.7M tokens, $96.27
• Time: 3h 53m

🟢 GPT Sol 6.1 (orchestrator) + GPT Luna 6 (executor)
• Sol: 38.2M tokens, $6.26
• Luna: 128.3M tokens, $1.80
• Total: 166.5M tokens, $8.06
• Time: 2h 16m

Much cheaper low quality, High quality more expensive? What is your favorite?
